text:
Priya: FYI BlueFjord hit a renewal flag (28 days). Their deployment stalled at integration step, and their PM said "blocked by webhook stability". Usage is down but they still have budget concerns. Need a short-term re-engage + downgrade-safe contingency.

Marco: Got it. Propose a 14-day pilot credit + runbook assist, then an exec sync. Try to avoid blanket discounts. If they push for price cuts, offer a staged downgrade (feature-flagged throughput, seat taper).

Julia-Enablement: I can run a 30-40m focused session: demo lite integration patterns and a one-page prod checklist. I have a prebuilt checklist we can adapt.

Priya: Good. Also heard they delayed SSO roll due to compliance review. Could be a blocker for adoption. Kai, any legal levers or playbook?

Kai: We shouldn't promise product changes, but we can expedite docs & a compliance call. Also OK to offer a "grace window" on commitment while they finish review.

dev-ops-bot: BlueFjord metrics snapshot: monthly active pipelines: 12 -> 4; API error rate: 1.2% -> 2.1%; top errors: webhook_timeouts, batch-upload 413. Recent deploys: 2 in last 30d.

Marco: Key messaging for outreach: consultative, low-effort. Offer: 1) 14-day pilot credits for migration/ops help, 2) enablement session this week, 3) exec sync to map priorities. Also share downgrade-safe options up front so they know plan B.

Priya: Draft outreach: "Hi Lena	6 noticed reduced activity. We can offer a 14-day migration pilot and a short enablement session to unblock webhooks and batch imports. If you'd prefer to adjust capacity temporarily, we can propose a staged downgrade that keeps core flows live. Would Tue 10am or Thu 3pm work?"

Julia-Enablement: Please include a short snippet for the call prep:```\nQuick webhook triage:\n- Confirm endpoint reachability + keepalive\n- Retries with exponential backoff\n- Ensure payload size < 5MB or chunk uploads\n```

Kai: Also add optional proposal: a temporary seat taper (reduce seats by X for 30d) or switch to a lower throughput tier plus cache rules. Both reversible.

Priya: Sending outreach now. I'll attach the pilot-credit terms: non-refundable credits for migration hours, 2 support sprints included.

dev-ops-bot: Outreach_sent by Priya at 4926000075.

Priya: Update: Lena replied at 4926000120: "Thanks	6 pilot sounds good, Thu 3pm preferred. We'll want the staged downgrade options in writing."

Marco: Lock Thu 3pm. Julia can run enablement; I'll prepare the staged downgrade doc and a one-slide decision tree: keep, taper, pause integrations.

Julia-Enablement: I'll prep the enablement deck and include a short playbook for on-call devs to triage webhook_timeouts.

Priya: Action items: Priya = finalize pilot credit terms + send confirmation (due EOD), Julia = enablement deck (due Wed), Marco = staged-downgrade slide + decision tree (due Wed), Kai = expedite compliance docs (reach out to legal).

Kai: I'll loop legal and try to get a 48h doc turnaround.

Priya: Nice, keep notes in this thread after the call. If they accept pilot, we'll treat as high-priority retention and escalate to enterprise CSM playbook. :white_check_mark:
